title: Nutty Spicy Slovakian Pork Stew
description: A spicy and comforting Slovakian dish featuring red wine jelly and tender pork, made with Buddhist temple friendly ingredients and cooked to perfection using sous vide.
instructions: Preheat the sous vide machine to 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, smoked paprika, ground cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Seal the pork cubes in a sous vide bag and cook for 24 hours.
In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onions until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the red wine jelly and cook until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked pork cubes to the pan and toss to coat with the sauce.
Sprinkle the chopped walnuts over the top of the stew and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
